d.id, d.dispute_no, d.order_id, d.applicant_id, ap.real_name AS applicant_name, ap.phone AS applicant_phone, d.respondent_id, rs.real_name AS respondent_name, rs.phone AS respondent_phone, d.dispute_type, d.description, d.evidence_images, d.apply_amount, d.order_status_before, d.status, d.handler_id, hd.real_name AS handler_name, d.handle_result, d.handle_time, d.village_id, v.village_name, d.create_time,
o.order_no, o.order_type, o.order_status, o.pay_amount, o.rent_start_date, o.rent_end_date, r.resource_name

FROM biz_dispute d JOIN biz_order o ON o.id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN biz_resource r ON r.id = o.resource_id JOIN sys_user ap ON ap.id = d.applicant_id JOIN sys_user rs ON rs.id = d.respondent_id
LEFT JOIN sys_user hd ON hd.id = d.handler_id LEFT JOIN sys_village v ON v.id = d.village_id
